output.why: The specification documents already conflict on the SG Unit-2 floor wash water transfer pumps: Section IA clause 7.1.13 (Part1.pdf p.43) specifies 'Two (2) nos. (1W+1S)', whereas the P&ID (Part3.pdf p.146) and Datasheet A (Part4.pdf p.58) both specify 'Two (2W) nos.' (2 working, 0 standby) at 105 m3/hr each. Making one pump a standby without resizing would halve the total pumping capacity from 210 m3/hr to 105 m3/hr and violate the 2W requirement in the P&ID and Datasheet.
